title: FIFA President Gianni Infantino faces growing criticism after scrapped World Cup stake sale plan
summary: FIFA President Gianni Infantino's plan to sell stakes in the World Cup was met with opposition from UEFA and CONCACAF, leading to a declaration of loss of confidence in his leadership. The proposal aimed to increase revenue for FIFA member associations but faced resistance due to concerns over governance and control. UEFA and CONCACAF claimed that the plan would have led to a loss of autonomy for national teams. The move has sparked criticism from some quarters, with Infantino facing questions about his ability to lead the organization effectively.
